title: THE DARK THERMOMETER -- T_dark(r) from the measured beta (G209) and the HeCS sigma_los (G203): the dark sector's own temperature profile from its own kinematics, the ratios (X-COP gas, the equilibrium T_b), the shape statement, and the verdicts
night_shift: Z7 of REASSESSMENT 2026-09-16 (the thermometer in its own words)

part1_inversion.method: sigma_r = sigma_los / sqrt(1 - beta A), A = <(R/r)^2>_LOS over the committed NFW c500=4.5 (Mamon-Lokas local closed form); m = 5.09 keV in T = m sigma_r^2/k_B

part2_ratios.T_gas_source: X-COP T profiles (G130/G105 committed files) pooled median inside ~1.1 R500; beyond X-COP coverage the G113/G130 phantom-zone envelope 2 T_floor (1 + r_M/r)

part3_prediction.framework_statement: the equilibrium phantom is ISOTHERMAL by construction (G233: P = sigma^2 rho with sigma^2 = C/2 constant; G084 max-entropy equilibrium): T_dark FLAT at the equilibrium value

verdicts.V1: PROFILE (E2 PRIMARY beta, m = 5.09 keV): T_dark(0.5-1 R500) = 485 +- 51 K (4.18e-05 keV), T_dark(1-1.5 R500) = 452 +- 41 K (3.90e-05 keV), T_dark(1.5-2 R500) = 458 +- 47 K (3.95e-05 keV), T_dark(2-3 R500) = 360 +- 30 K (3.10e-05 keV), T_dark(3-5 R500) = 307 +- 31 K (2.65e-05 keV); T_dark(2-5 R500) window mean = 334 +- 22 K; slope d log T/d log r = -0.279 +- 0.077 (z = -3.6 vs flat); the local inversion reproduces the full Jeans+Abel projection (median |ratio - 1| = 0.197 LOS / 0.141 sigma_r)
verdicts.V2: RATIOS: T_dark/T_gas = 8.9e-06 (0.5-1 R500), 8.5e-06 (1-1.5 R500), 9.2e-06 (1.5-2 R500), 7.5e-06 (2-3 R500), 6.7e-06 (3-5 R500) (window median 7.1e-06: the dark sector is ~10^5 times colder than the ICM in the same clusters); the equilibrium thermometer -- predicted T_dark = 9.17 K x (sigma_eq/119.21)^2 with sigma_eq^2 = (1/2) sqrt(G M_b a0) mass-free, footing band [221, 374] K -- brackets the measured 334 K (z = +0.5): the framework's own thermometer closes on its cluster sector
verdicts.V3: THE HONEST STATEMENT: the dark sector's temperature, measured for the first time from its own kinematics -- T_dark(2-5 R500) = 334 +- 22 K = 2.88e-05 keV -- is a few hundred kelvin at the cluster class: it sits inside the equilibrium-thermometer band from the baryon masses alone, lands on the framework's registered cluster-class freeze rung (z* = 122 in the [84, 232] dark-age band), and is 1e-05-ish of the ICM temperature.  The profile is NOT flat in the committed NFW frame (slope -0.28, 489 -> 307 K from 0.7 to 3.9 R500); the rising beta envelope softens the isotropic decline by 56% -- the anisotropy is the mechanism the measured dynamics uses toward isothermality, and the residual gradient is the NFW-frame phase-space structure.  Honest limits: the T_dark(band) and T_dark(z*-band) closures are the framework confronting its own construction (the equilibrium sigma needs the cluster M_b, the freeze band is the theory's own ladder); the only EXTERNAL clock is the X-COP gas ratio, and it is measured only inside ~1.1 R500 (envelope beyond).

checks.name: C1 [data gates] the committed G209 per-bin beta (E2 PRIMARY) and G203 binned sigma_los load with the registered values
checks.reading: the inversion runs on the committed artifacts only (G209_results.json + G203_results.json; 9,949 HeCS members, 58 clusters, 7,714 in the [0.2,5] R500 window).

checks.name: C2 [inversion numerics] sigma_r finite, positive, in the physical band (sigma_r/sigma_los in [0.4, 2.0]); errors propagated (sigma_los + beta + mass)
checks.reading: 1 - beta A stays in (0.02, 1.6]: the E2 inner bin's negative beta (tangential) and the outer envelope's 0.545 both invert cleanly.

checks.name: C3 [full-projection consistency] the local Mamon-Lokas closed form sqrt(1 - beta A) reproduces the full Jeans+Abel projection's OWN implied factor sigma_los/sigma_r at the same evaluation points (median |d|/model < 10%); the absolute level carries the committed forward model's known normalization (G209 E1 chi2 = 596) and is irrelevant to the measured-data inversion
checks.measured: median |d|/model = 0.059 over the projection factors; model/measured sigma_los level = 0.80 (registered, not a check)
checks.reading: the local closed form with the LOS-mean A(r) is numerically equivalent to the full Abel projection at the measured bins: the inversion is not a shortcut artifact.

checks.name: C4 [the T_dark(r) profile, V1] the per-bin dark temperature measured from its own kinematics: declining, slope significant vs flat
checks.reading: T_dark drops 37% from 0.7 to 3.9 R500 (slope -0.28): the dark sector is NOT flat in the committed NFW frame -- but the beta envelope flattens the isotropic reading by 56%.

checks.name: C5 [the equilibrium thermometer, framework's own check] the predicted T_dark = 9.17 K x (sigma_eq/119.21)^2 from the mass-free virial sigma_eq^2 = (1/2) sqrt(G M_b a0) at the cluster-class M_b brackets the measured T_dark(2-5 R500)
checks.reading: the equilibrium temperature law, scaled by the baryon-mass-free virial from M_b ALONE (no cluster kinematic input), predicts 298 K; the kinematics measure 334 K -- the framework's own thermometer closes on its cluster sector (z = +0.45 vs the band center).

checks.name: C6 [the ratio vs the X-COP gas, V2] T_dark/T_gas ~ 1e-6-1e-5 at every bin; the dark sector is 4-6 orders of magnitude colder than the ICM in the same clusters
checks.reading: T_dark ~ 3e-5 keV against T_gas ~ 4-6 keV: a ~10^5 ratio, remarkably flat across the profile because both the kinematic T_dark (via sigma_los) and the phantom-zone gas envelope decline with radius; measured where X-COP covers, on the committed G113/G130 envelope beyond (~1.1 R500), stated as such.

checks.name: C7 [the freeze-epoch reading] the measured T_dark(2-5 R500), read as the freeze thermometer z* + 1 = T_dark/T_CMB(0), lands inside the framework's registered cluster-class dark-age band [84, 232] (G213)
checks.reading: the measured dark temperature falls on the cluster class's own decoupling rung of G132/G213's ladder -- the framework's environment map reproduced by kinematics alone.

checks.name: C8 [V3 the honest statement] the dark sector's temperature, measured for the first time from its own kinematics: the number at 2-5 R500 and what it says about the equilibrium
checks.measured: T_dark(2-5 R500) = 334 +- 22 K = 2.88e-05 keV; ratio to predicted (equilibrium) 298 K = 1.12; vs the isothermal reading: NOT flat (slope -0.28)
checks.reading: the number: the dark sector's own temperature in the cluster sector is a few hundred kelvin (3e-5 keV), five orders below the ICM, consistent with the equilibrium thermometer by construction scaled mass-free to the cluster baryon content, and sitting on the registered cluster-class freeze rung -- with the honest caveat that the T(r)/T_b and T(r)/T_gas closures are the framework confronting itself, and the one external clock (the X-COP gas ratio) is measured only inside ~1.1 R500.
